label: Tesla Hourly Wake
info: Wakes the car at most once an hour, 8 AM-5 PM Central, when battery/solar would allow a start, the car is home, the charger status is 0 or 2, and the inverter (car only) is under 300 W. The driver then reads the real plug state and the Tesla Auto-Start Charging tab starts charging. See docs/11-plug-detection-and-auto-start.md. Runs /data/tesla/node-red-tesla.py wake.
